newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Oct/June sugar sales higher at 2.07 mln T.
newsitem.headline: German Oct/June sugar sales higher at 2.07 mln T.

text.p: German sugar sales in the first nine months of the 1996/97 (Oct-Sept) season were 2.07 million tonnes, slightly up from 2.05 million in Oct/June 1995/96, sugar industry association WVZ data showed.
Sales in Oct/May had been slightly below the previous season.
Sugar sales in June of 261,706 tonnes compared with 225,525 tonnes in May and 236,909 in June 1996.
Sugar production in June was 10,134 (6,194 in June 1996).
Stocks at the end of June were 1.26 million tonnes versus 1.12 million a year earlier.
Carry-in stocks on October 1, 1996 had been 239,562 tonnes (250,854 a year earlier).
June imports of 6,518 tonnes were down from 8,309 tonnes a year earlier, while exports of 105,133 tonnes compared with 64,199 in June 1996.
